After the main channel is interrupted, the system will automatically restore and the backup channel will be available throughout the entire process. Risk: Basic network score is 2 points, with 1 point added for unregistered device access, totaling 3 points, indicating a "serious" level. Please complete port blocking and backfilling before the information security post 16:21. Irrelevant note: B-18539 batch meter verification is scheduled for 2026-11-21 afternoon. Supplementary conclusion: this case does not amount to "Communication or cyber-security issue".
